Avails.description:
Spec per-product RESPONSE record for ``POST /products/avails``.

``price`` stays a float per the OpenDirect 2.1 decimal dialect (the
FD-11 exception documented in the module docstring).

availability.description: Quantity available for booking in the date range.
availability.title: Availability

enddate.description: Echo of the requested delivery end (spec-required).
enddate.title: Enddate

price.description: The product's price (spec-required; OpenDirect 2.1 float dialect, FD-11 exception).
price.title: Price

productid.description: Product the availability + pricing is for (spec-required).
productid.title: Productid

startdate.description: Echo of the requested delivery start (spec-required).
startdate.title: Startdate

Avails.title: Avails

AvailsStatus.description: Spec ``Object: AvailsStatus`` — availability grouping for a product.

context.description: ProductTargeting entries describing the context of a Partially Available or Unavailable status.
context.title: Context

producttargeting.description: ProductTargeting entries describing the inventory at this status (spec-required).
producttargeting.title: Producttargeting

reason.description: Spec-enumerated reason when Partially Available or Unavailable.

AvailsStatus.title: AvailsStatus

AvailsStatusReason.description: Spec ``AvailsStatus.reason``: why inventory is not fully available.
AvailsStatusReason.title: AvailsStatusReason

AvailsStatusValue.description: Spec ``AvailsStatus.status`` (note the space in the middle value).
AvailsStatusValue.title: AvailsStatusValue

ProductTargeting.description:
Spec ``Object: ProductTargeting`` — dimensional targeting/metrics.

All-lowercase wire names per the normative table; the six starred
attributes are required.

datasource.description: Data source that defines the target vocabulary (third-party schemas welcome by design).
datasource.title: Datasource

default.description: Default targetvalue(s) when the buyer selects none.
default.title: Default

name.description: What is described: Inventory, Delivery, Distribution, Investment, or Prohibitions.

selectable.description: Whether a buyer may select from targetvalues or the values are fixed.
selectable.title: Selectable

targetvalues.description: One or more values for the target (strings on the wire).
targetvalues.title: Targetvalues

type.description: How it is quantified: Frames, Audience, Investment, or Total.

ProductTargeting.title: ProductTargeting

TargetingUnit.description: Spec ``ProductTargeting.type``: how the entry is quantified.
TargetingUnit.title: TargetingUnit

description:
Spec response envelope: the ``avails`` collection object.

Per the spec's Collection Objects table the ``POST /products/avails``
response must be an object whose array property is named ``avails``
(one record per requested product; empty when nothing matches).

avails.description: One Avails record per product in the request.
avails.title: Avails

title: AvailsCollection
